# MvLO Ranked

> Unofficial, community-made ranked ladder for MvLO (Mario vs Luigi Online). Tracks ranked 1v1 matches, ELO ratings and a five-tier rank system, with login via Discord.

MvLO Ranked is a fan-run ranked matchmaking system for the MvLO community game. Players log in with Discord, queue for ranked 1v1 matches, and climb a single shared ELO ladder split into five tiers (Mini, Mushroom, Shell, Fireflower, Star), each with three divisions.

## Pages

- [Leaderboard](https://mvloranked.xyz/): Top-players leaderboard, the ranked ruleset, and (once logged in) the viewer's own match history.
- [Tier Map](https://mvloranked.xyz/tiers.html): Every tier and division on the ladder, and the ELO range each one covers.
- Player profiles at `https://mvloranked.xyz/user/:id`: a player's rank, ELO rating and recent match history.

## Notes

- This is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with Nintendo.
- Full match rules, the rating system and fair-play/account-integrity policies are on the Leaderboard page under its RULES tab.
